titleBack: This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)

flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when you OCCUPY Corellia system AND CONTROL two Corellia battleground sites with Corellians.

children.req: occupy: owner occupies Corellia system (presence suffices, control not required)
control WITH actor, count 2: owner controls 2 Corellia battleground sites each with a Corellian
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, 2, Filters.and(Filters.Corellia_site, Filters.battleground), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.Corellian)

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToFront.prose: Flips back when you do NOT occupy two battlegrounds (any battlegrounds, not Corellia-specific). NOTE: the printed game text's exception '(unless you have completed two Kessel Runs)' is NOT implemented - no Kessel Run check exists in the code.

children.req: occupy count 2: owner occupies two battlegrounds

requirementSemantics: Front flip mixes OCCUPY and CONTROL-WITH: occupies(Corellia_system) - presence only - AND controlsWith(2, Corellia battleground sites, Corellian) - full control of two such sites each with a Corellian there (SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE).

Back flip-back is OCCUPY count semantics on GENERIC battlegrounds: occupies(playerId, 2, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.battleground) - NOT Corellia-specific; any two occupied battlegrounds anywhere hold the back side.

CODE-VS-TEXT DIVERGENCE (back): printed text says 'unless you have completed two Kessel Runs' - no such exception is coded. Printed back text also describes smuggler Force generation/battle destiny/forfeit/interrupt-from-Lost-Pile/Sense-Alter-KYEO bans, none of which are implemented; the code instead implements Corellia-specific modifiers (weapon destiny -2 for non-blaster character weapons at Corellia sites, Force generation +1 at Corellia spaceport sites, combat vehicle deploy/move lockouts, Palejo Reshad game-text mod, BoShek/Corellian download, end-of-turn bottom-of-Reserve draw). Truth recorded = code.
Front's extra deploy cost ('place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to deploy a card with ability to Corellia') is an unimplemented TODO comment in BOTH files (front:97, BACK:62).
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Corellia system, an unpiloted freighter to Corellia system (DeploymentRestrictionsOption.allowToDeployUnpilotedToSystemOrSector), a Corellian pilot to Corellia system, and <>Spaceport City to Corellia (DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect, Title.Corellia) (front:57-89).
Front pull: once per turn, use 1 Force to deploy a <> (DIAMOND_1) site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (front:103-124).
Back pull: once during your deploy phase, deploy BoShek or a Corellian of ability < 3 from Reserve Deck (BACK:72-91).
Back: at end of each turn, may use 1 Force to draw bottom card of Reserve Deck into hand (optional trigger, BACK:94-111).
otherObligations: Both sides: Corellia sites immune to No Escape (front:96; BACK:61).
Front: you may not Force drain at Corellia system (front:98).
Back: non-blaster character weapons at Corellia sites: each weapon destiny -2 (BACK:63).
Back: your Force generation +1 at Corellia spaceport sites (BACK:64).
Back: your combat vehicles may not deploy or move except to Corellia sites where opponent has a vehicle (BACK:65-66).
Back: Palejo Reshad treats Audience Chamber as Corellia (ModifyGameTextModifier, BACK:67).
UNIMPLEMENTED (TODO in code, both sides): extra cost (place card from hand on bottom of Used Pile) for either player deploying a card with ability (except Corellian) to Corellia (front:97; BACK:62).

Strategic note from law: front flip needs Corellians parked on two CONTROLLED Corellia battleground sites plus any presence at Corellia system; after flip, only generic 2-battleground occupation must be maintained (per code - the Kessel Run escape hatch does not exist).

profileGaps: No profile exists in objective_playbooks.json for frontBp 601_146 (Legacy block-4 card, hideFromDeckBuilder; also absent from both seed facts files).

If a profile is created: flip gate = occupy Corellia system + controlsWith(2, Corellia battleground sites, Corellian); flip-back guard = keep occupying 2 battlegrounds anywhere; key actor = Filters.Corellian; note the back's printed-text-vs-code divergence (no Kessel Run exception coded) before encoding any Kessel Run logic.
